students.name: Rakshit G. Hosamani
students.biography: A researcher working at the intersection of environmental science and advanced materials, with a PhD focused on developing catalytic systems for wastewater treatment and dye degradation. My work bridges materials science with forest ecology and plant ecophysiology, including field campaigns measuring photosynthetic thermal tolerance in canopy trees across the Bhadra Tiger Reserve and Goa. Alongside experimental research, I actively engage in biodiversity conservation and community outreach through regional bird and nature walks.
